newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns AA- rating to Korea Elec $100 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA- rating to Korea Elec $100 mln bond.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it had assigned an AA- rating to Korea Electric Power Corp's $100 million worth of six percent straight bond maturing on December 1, 2026.

The rating reflects its close ties with the government, its strategic role in the national economy, a favourable regulatory regime, and its strong operational and financial profiles, S&P said. It said the rating outlook is stable.
"Continued favourable regulatory treatment is expected to maintain the company's strong financial profile in the face of heavy investment requirements," it said in a statement.
